card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.

mechanism: A seeks all routine car-log fields to conceal which answer matters, even when B offers the likely key detail first.
confusable: Unlike pointed interrogation, A must maintain the cover of complete neutral recordkeeping.
comparison: A fetches the log rather than accept driver alone; protected D174-a remains untouched.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
